title: GoOrganicAfrica Comoros calculator readiness review — Batch 20

administrative_geography.note: Three autonomous islands are used as top-level selector. INSEED microdata supports island, prefecture, commune and village aggregation; lower levels are not mixed into the selector.

evidence_findings: INSEED published RGA-2 results for the 2023/2024 crop campaign and May 2024-April 2025 livestock reference period; the census was conducted with FAO technical support and World Bank financing.
The RGA-2 listed 73,818 family holdings across 964 enumeration areas, separately enumerated 148 modern/institutional holdings and sampled 11,454 family holdings for detailed survey.
National agricultural structure: 89,282 ha agricultural land, 56,576 ha cultivated, average holding 0.40 ha, and 85% of holdings under 1 ha.
Land by island: Ngazidja 44,561 ha, Ndzuwani 37,191 ha, Mwali 7,531 ha.
National crop totals include banana 72,809 t, cassava 59,149 t, sweet potato 11,684 t, vanilla 2,442 t, clove 2,178 t and ylang-ylang 355 t.

Selected yields reported in the public summary: mango 17.1 t/ha, lettuce 8.5 t/ha and cucumber 8.3 t/ha. Denominator, island and production-system detail still require validation from the full tables.

Only 20% of cultivated land was fertilised; among fertilised land, 54% used organic fertiliser, 29% mineral fertiliser and 17% combined. 10% of crop producers used phytosanitary products. These are adoption indicators, not unit costs.
Livestock data include 49,679 livestock holdings, 270,571 poultry, 116,674 goats and 55,835 cattle.
INSEED NADA's RGA-2 version 1.0 metadata states that files were cleaned, weighted and validated by the technical committee; microdata access is subject to application and confidentiality conditions.
RGA-2 supports island, prefecture, commune and village geography; the top-level selector uses the three autonomous islands.

criteria.crop_area_production_yield_by_commodity_: partial — strong 2023/24 national crop totals and selected yields; detailed weighted island/crop/season tables still to extract
criteria.dated_local_farmgate_prices_and_units: blocked — no validated dated island-level farmgate series
criteria.seed_and_planting_material_costs: blocked — adoption/production data do not provide current farmer-paid prices
criteria.fertilizer_and_soil_amendment_costs: partial — fertiliser adoption shares available, but quantities and unit costs not validated
criteria.crop_protection_costs: partial — phytosanitary adoption share available, but products, quantities and paid prices missing
criteria.labour_rates_and_operations: partial — census labour structure documented; operation-specific wage rates and costs not extracted
criteria.machinery_and_land_preparation_costs: blocked — no current farmer-paid cost schedule
criteria.currency_and_exchange_rate_method: partial — KMF identified; calculator conversion and rounding still to validate
criteria.source_provenance_and_observation_date: partial — official INSEED RGA-2 sources and reference periods recorded; detailed tables outstanding
criteria.calculator_mapping_and_test_cases: blocked — no validated mapping or country tests

blockers: Obtain authorised access to the RGA-2 microdata or complete official weighted island/prefecture crop tables; extract crop, season, harvested area, production and yield with final survey weights.
Reconcile crop-specific denominators and mixed/intercropped production, units and campaign reference periods before calculating yield distributions.
Obtain dated island-level farmgate prices and units for priority commodities; do not substitute retail prices or export values.
Obtain farmer-paid seed, planting-material, organic/mineral fertiliser, crop-protection, labour, irrigation, water, energy, machinery, packaging and transport costs by island.
Build representative island-specific enterprise budgets and gross margins that reflect small and fragmented holdings and subsistence versus sale orientation.
Validate KMF currency handling, calculator commodity mapping and country-specific test cases.
safeguards: Comoros remains research-only and not active.
Do not modify the 10 active country profiles or calculator formulas.
Do not treat national production totals or selected yield indicators as farm budgets or island-level values.
Do not treat input adoption shares as input costs.
Respect INSEED microdata access and confidentiality conditions.
next_step: Request or access the authorised RGA-2 microdata and extract weighted crop area, production, yields, sales and labour by island/prefecture; in parallel collect dated farmgate prices and farmer-paid input quotations.
